description: This file is a generated Java class that registers Flutter plugins with the Android embedding engine. It primarily adds specific plugins such as SharedPreferencesPlugin and SqflitePlugin to the FlutterEngine.

classes.name: GeneratedPluginRegistrant
classes.description: A final class responsible for registering Flutter plugins with the Flutter engine. It includes a static method 'registerWith' to perform plugin registration.

methods.name: registerWith
methods.description: Registers the specified plugins with the provided FlutterEngine instance by adding plugin instances to the engine's plugin registry. Includes exception handling and logging.
